description: PURCHASE a shipping label for a shipment at a chosen rate. WARNING: this CHARGES the EasyPost account balance and is irreversible except by requesting a refund (easypost_refund_shipment). Pick a rate_id from the rates returned by easypost_create_shipment or easypost_get_shipment. API: POST /shipments/{id}/buy (body { rate: { id }, insurance? }).

insurance.description: Dollar amount to insure the shipment for, e.g. "249.99".

rate_id.description: Rate id to purchase (from create_shipment / get_shipment rates).

shipment_id.description: Shipment id to buy, e.g. shp_...

name: easypost_buy_shipment
title: Buy a shipping label
